detail.longDescription: I’m running a Debian server on leasedweb as a virtual server package. I’ve installed ISPConfig on it and it runs multiple websites of various capacities and a few email domains. Anyone out there have any experience in this kind of arrangement adding in running docker containers? I could completely revamp the thing using proxmox or something but I don’t have time to go through that whole process so at this point Im just making a new site and user from which to run and connect to a docker profile that itself will run redis and the database for my selfhost. Wish me luck over the next little while while I try to do this without breaking anything in ISPconfig 😆 # ispconfig # webadmin # debian # docker # mastoadmin
